scope.execution: Read-only local VM execution of the same repository-owned builders used by the browser and server catalog; no tests, build, provider calls or external source acquisition.
scope.reproduction: See TEACHING_QUALITY_PLAN.md section Reproducing the structural evidence. The temporary extractor was removed; the pinned snapshot retains source hashes, rule definitions, collection conventions and addressable output, not the exact extraction source.
scope.coverage: All current N5-N1 raw OpenJLPT records, authored exam records, practical units, reachable lesson surfaces and generated check/full-exam inventories. Linguistic correctness is not established by these structural rules.
scope.raw_record_key: source file plus id/character/word; raw source bytes remain unchanged.
scope.lesson_key: Level plus activityId; aliases deduplicated. Seven differences separately verified to be added id metadata only.
scope.question_identity: Level + canonical lesson id + collection + zero-based index; check_item_ids retains generated-check progress bindings. Full-exam positions are retained in per-level counts and original authored-exam addresses.
scope.editorial: No human editorial approval. Untranslated-source and ambiguity flags are candidates, not automatic linguistic verdicts.

TQ01.definition: Quiz study examples assign a solution rationale or correct option to vi, which generic reference UI labels as meaning/translation.

TQ02.definition: An authored exam question has a passage but its study example has no passage field. The full practice prompt may retain it; this does not mean all question views lose it.

TQ03.definition: A source kanji question declares a target; the derived flat practice prompt does not explicitly identify that target in its instruction and cannot style a target field because it is omitted.

TQ04.definition: A quiz lesson has fewer than five original drills but the shared check generator adds derived checks to reach five.

TQ05.definition: Visible lesson checks contain fewer questions than the source drills; full canonical exam inventory may preserve the rest. Coverage/design issue, not a data-deletion claim.

TQ06.definition: A displayed check has no nonempty explanation field. An on-demand AI explanation is separate, fallible and may be unavailable.

TQ07.definition: A generated check has missing prompt/answer, fewer than two distinct choices, duplicate choices, or answer absent/multiply present. No semantic equivalence inferred.

TQ08.definition: Every displayed OpenJLPT vocabulary or kanji check in the lesson is a meaning-recognition prompt.

TQ09.definition: A known source English field containing Latin letters is absent from the current translation dictionary. Some names/terms may legitimately remain unchanged; runtime teaching can translate on request.

TQ10.definition: An OpenJLPT grammar lesson has fewer than three source examples. This is a coverage flag, not proof the examples are wrong.

TQ11.definition: Canonical lesson overview has no explicit measurable authored learning objective; a title/summary or gloss is not assumed to be a reviewed objective.

TQ12.definition: Distinct displayed prompt/answer pairs within one lesson reuse an item_id. Requires consumer/progress review before replacement.

inspection_limits: All raw records structurally traversed; not all Japanese sentences manually or independently teacher-reviewed.
Full-corpus linguistic correctness, distractor equivalence, translation fidelity, JLPT sentence-level suitability and real-provider teaching quality remain unverified.
Official publisher documents/audio were not downloaded or reproduced; linked answer-sheet metadata was structurally counted only.
Source acquisition commit6de1df1 was metadata-only when inspected; later active unmerged acquisition/RAG work is outside this pinned main baseline and not accepted or authorized by this audit.
Five-check and full-exam collections overlap; counts are occurrences, not independently approved or distinct questions.
Source-language fallback candidates can include names and legitimate untranslated terms; source structural coverage is not exhaustive semantic approval.

practical_units.question_jp: はじめまして。お名前とお仕事を教えてください。
何をご注文ですか。
何時から何時まで勉強しますか。いつ会いましょうか。
このバスについて、運転手に何を聞きますか。
いらっしゃいませ。何をお探しですか。
わからない言葉があったら、どう聞きますか。
今どこですか。何時ごろ着きますか。
いつ休みたいですか。仕事の準備はどうしますか。
今日はどうしましたか。いつからですか。
何曜日の何時に、何名様でご予約ですか。
作業の順番を説明してください。わからないときはどうしますか。
どんな故障ですか。いつ修理に伺えばよろしいですか。
このメールを受け取ったら、どうやって本物か確認しますか。
在庫が不足していたら、どんな順番で対応しますか。
これまでの経験と、今できるようになったことを教えてください。
資料室の規定で、例外として認められるのはどんな場合ですか。
どちらの印刷会社を選びますか。数字を使って理由を説明してください。
会議を減らす案について、利点とリスクをどう評価しますか。
手続きの統一と例外的な支援は両立しますか。本文を踏まえて説明してください。
研修の評価について、二人の共通点と相違点を説明してください。

location_conventions.lesson_issues: Each lesson row issues[rule_id] lists zero-based indices in that rule location_collection; lesson-scoped [0] marks the whole lesson. Raw-source candidates are grouped by source file with [source array index, original id].
location_conventions.check_item_ids: Array index equals generated-check index; values are original stable progress bindings, not a new identity scheme.
location_conventions.collection_counts: Different collections can overlap. Do not sum them to claim unique authored questions or calculate a corpus-wide semantic error rate.
location_conventions.source_language_candidates: The compact record-level queue omits repeated source field strings. Reinspect the pinned source record and role before translation or editorial judgment.
location_conventions.zero_lessons_for_TQ09: This rule is measured in raw source records, not mapped generated lessons. The zero affected_lessons value is not a claim that no learner-facing lesson is affected.

editorial_review.kind: AI editorial review, not human approval

confirmed_internal_contradictions.finding: Four supplied parts, explanation uses three; star position and selected part disagree.
Four supplied parts cannot assemble five-piece explanation; unsupplied わかる appears in answer choices.
Explanation third part 私は disagrees with stored selected fourth part 決して.
Explanation third part 従わ disagrees with stored selected fourth part ざる.
Named にほかならない construction disagrees with assembled 結晶にほかにならない.

Accident context may allow both delayed and stopped train.

practical_alignment.finding: Written production model is not complete for the separate spoken question asking current location. Keep task/rubric scopes separate.
Written model drops day 1 from the effective date although source includes it and criteria require the effective date.

answer_position_bias.interpretation: Assessment-design issue, not proof keys are wrong. Any display randomization must preserve canonical original option identity.

repeated_option_non_defect.interpretation: Two legitimate separately identified positions; do not deduplicate strings.

additional_findings.finding: Preview deduplicates/reorders source option strings and grades text rather than original option IDs.
AI helper mounting overwrites structured full-quiz rendering before inference.
Practice hides reference content without independently rendering ordinary lesson passage/dialogue.
Hint evidence includes example translations or rationales that can expose the answer.
Writing checkboxes and dictation self-ratings use correctness/SRS records; this is not objective mastery.
Manual completion, preview coverage and graded evidence are distinct, currently conflated in some labels/flows.
Example associations use text/answer equality and fallback; quiz catalog receives fallback listening skill.
Weak-item review uses display text instead of an explicit canonical item selector.
Full-quiz feedback/task changes and flashcard side need accessible announcements; Japanese content needs appropriate language annotation.

verification.reason: Investigation-only checkpoint; actual local builder output is structural proof, not semantic or UI acceptance.
